name: Blood Parasites debuffs the target of Taldaram's Torment (#3287)
contract: Blood Parasites 802315 reads 'Your Taldaram's Torment now generates $/10;s1 additional Rage per tick and increases spell critical strike chance against the target by $800988s1% for $800988d'. Effect 1 is aura 42 (proc trigger spell) on Blood Parasites 800988 (MOD_ATTACKER_SPELL_AND_WEAPON_CRIT_CHANCE, BasePoints 2 -> +3%, TargetA 6). Spell.dbc gives 802315 ProcFlags 0 and no spell_proc row existed, so SpellMgr::LoadSpellProcs skipped it and the debuff never landed. Effect 0 is the Rage clause (aura 107 SPELLMOD_EFFECT1 +30 on EffectSpellClassMask (0, 128, 0)) and is not exercised here. Taldaram's Torment is cast as 800772 itself, SpellFamilyFlags (0, 0, 2097152), the mask the new row uses.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
SETUP: the Blood Parasites passive is active
No Blood Parasites debuff before the cast
SETUP: Taldaram's Torment is applied to the target
DISCRIMINATING: the target gains Blood Parasites 800988
Blood Parasites grants the DBC value of +3% crit taken
